method: Exact complete PROP_LOC address matched to official MOD-IV tax parcel; municipality read from PCL_MUN/CD_CODE/MUN_NAME, not postal address
limitations: Statewide parcel polygons are not land-ownership surveys. This evidence concerns municipal tax assignment of the complete property address; no formal boundary/title determination is claimed.
